picker-awt-preparation:
    if: github.repository == 'Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.profile == 'picker-awt-preparation'
    runs-on: macos-26
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@b725eda525362e7cf34af9a7243cac1e3f01a7ec
        with:
          toolchain: '1.98.0'
      - uses: actions/setup-java@b6effb05e454b25005698d916606bdc6ffcbf961
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
          verify-signature: true
          overwrite-settings: false
      - name: Standard owned preparation once, zero inventory or native tests or accepted controls
        run: python3 -B scripts/ci/picker_awt_preparation.py --output build/ci-verification/picker-awt-preparation
      - name: Preserve only five allowlisted JSON receipts, including failed preparation observations
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        with:
          name: picker-awt-preparation-evidence
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            build/ci-verification/picker-awt-preparation/receipt.json
            build/ci-verification/picker-awt-preparation/inputs-before.json
            build/ci-verification/picker-awt-preparation/inputs-after.json
            build/ci-verification/picker-awt-preparation/runtime-before.json
            build/ci-verification/picker-awt-preparation/runtime-after.json

def prepare_command(root: Path, private: Path) -> list[str]:
    properties = _jvm_properties(root, private)
    home = private / "gradle-home"
    # Command-local JDK launcher startup options, NOT trailing Gradle -D flags.
    # The inherited controller environment/shared process owner are unchanged.
    # The qualified Java launcher reads these before Gradle client initialization;
    # standard Java children inherit them. This is not Cargo/global hermeticity.
    return [GRADLE_STARTUP_ENV.as_posix(), "JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS=" + " ".join(properties),
            "./gradlew", "--no-daemon", "--console=plain", "--max-workers=2", "--gradle-user-home",
            home.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
            "-Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=" + STANDARD_GRADLE_JVM_ARGS + " " + " ".join(properties),
            "-Pkotlin.daemon.jvmargs=" + STANDARD_KOTLIN_DAEMON_JVM_ARGS + " " + " ".join(properties),
            "-PnativecmpkitNativeMode=host", *PREPARE_TASKS]
